Overview

This feature service provides building footprint information for Westbank First Nation, supporting a current view of built structures within the community.

Feature Layers

  • WFN Buildings — Polygon features representing individual building footprints. The layer includes building classification and detail attributes, along with basic measurements such as height, area, and perimeter-related information, which support planning, asset inventory, and spatial analysis.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the Westbank First Nation area in British Columbia, Canada.

Use Cases

  • Community and land-use planning
  • Building inventory and asset management
  • Map display and reference for local infrastructure
  • Spatial analysis of building distribution and development
